Title: Native Mongo shell on Azure Cosmos DB API for MongoDB is now in preview

Body.Content:
Execute Mongo database commands directly on top of your database account using the native Mongo shell in the Azure Cosmos DB Data Explorer. This is currently available in the Australia East, East US, East US 2, North Europe, South Central US, Southeast Asia, UK South, West Europe, and West US 2 regions.

To use it, go to the Data Explorer in either the Azure portal or in cosmos.azure.com, then click Open Mongo Shell to start an instance of the Mongo shell in your browser.

Learn more.
